versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the questionnaire-generator skill.
- Provides standardized UX and human factors questionnaires (SUS, ASQ, SEQ, NASA-TLX, UEQ, CSUQ, SMILE scale) with scoring instructions.
- Guides users in selecting appropriate questionnaires based on evaluation goals.
- Outputs full questionnaires, scoring methods, interpretation thresholds, and usage recommendations.
- Designed for usability testing and subjective assessments in UX coursework.
